instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text is strictly in PT-PT (Português de Portugal), using terms like 'Faturação', 'Comprovativo', 'Relatórios', 'Monitorização', 'Definições', 'Utilizadores'.
Use data-testid attributes on ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, modals).
Primary colors must strictly follow #0B1A30 (Navy Dark), #FFFFFF (White), #F8FAFC (Light Gray bg), and #D4AF37 (Gold accent).
Integrate Lucide-react or Phosphor icons throughout navigation and metrics cards.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, popovers, or headers. Always specify solid or heavy backdrop blur background.
Ensure responsiveness across desktop, tablet, and mobile displays.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.data_testid_requirement: Mandatory on all clickable, submit, input, tab, and card elements
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.theme_rules: Strictly dark navy #0B1A30 for sidebar & crypto central hero cards; crisp off-white #F8FAFC for dashboard body background; rich gold #D4AF37 for badges, highlights, and primary CTAs.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.font_setup: Import Outfit and Inter from Google Fonts in public/index.html or index.css.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.export_functionality: Provide downloadable CSV/XLSX and simulated PDF generation for Invoices, Reports, and Calculation tables.
